column3: MT 13:2. “dreamer of dreams” renders “dreamer of a dream.”
MT 13:3. “comes true” renders “comes”; NASB puts “whom you have not known” in parentheses, and “serve” renders “be enticed to serve.”
MT 13:4. “to find out if you love” renders “to know whether you are loving”; “soul” renders “being.”
MT 13:6. “counseled rebellion” renders “spoken rebellion”; “seduce” renders “thrust aside,” and “purge” renders “remove.”
MT 13:7. “the wife you cherish” renders “the wife of your bosom”; NASB opens a parenthesis that runs into verse 7.
MT 13:8. NASB closes its parenthesis here; “from one end of the earth to the other end” renders “from the end of the earth to the end of the earth.”
MT 13:11. “stone him to death” renders “stone him with stones, and he shall die”; “seduce” renders “thrust aside.”
MT 13:12. “never again do” renders “not again do.”
MT 13:14. “worthless men” renders “men, sons of worthlessness”; NASB puts “whom you have not known” in parentheses.
MT 13:15. NASB supplies “if”; the Hebrew reads “and behold, it is true.”
MT 13:16. “the edge of the sword” renders “the mouth of the sword”; “utterly destroying” renders the verb for devoting to destruction.
MT 13:17. “a ruin forever” renders “a mound of perpetuity.”
MT 13:18. “that which is put under the ban” renders “the things devoted to destruction”; “show mercy to you” renders “give you compassion.”
